summary: Iteration 5 verified the new bulletproof RetOps scoring engine end-to-end. Backend: extended /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py by 8 tests (TestScoringEngineSchema x3, TestSeededBusinessExpectations x3, TestHardFailGate x1, TestChurnMath x1) on top of the existing 29, total 37 — all pass against the public URL. Validated: (a) every seeded interaction.analysis has the new schema: qa_status in {excellent|good|watch|below_threshold}, qa_breakdown with all 6 weighted keys (greeting 10, active_listening 20, problem_solving 25, empathy 15, resolution 20, closing 10) each with int score 0-100 + correct weight + reason, compliance {has_violation, violation_types[]}, churn {risk_score 0-100, risk_level low/medium/high/critical, signals[], keywords_matched[], revenue_at_risk, recommended_action}, sentiment dict, interaction_tags[], coaching {strengths[], improvements[]}, playbook {triggered}, summary; (b) Weighted qa_score = round(sum(score_i * weight_i)/100) within ±1 for every non-capped interaction; (c) Acme seeded interaction risk_score=65 (high), 5 signals, revenue_at_risk=$9,360; (d) Summit AI (Support Bot v3 'unlimited' claim) → ai_verdict=BLOCK, compliance fail, qa_score capped at 59; (e) NovaTech Emma Davis → risk_score=10 (low), compliance pass, qa_score=77.5 (good); (f) Legacy back-compat fields rubric[6], coaching_card, save_playbook, policy_compliance, ai_hallucination, churn_risk (Low/Medium/High), arr_at_risk, churn_signal, sentiment, expansion_signal, expansion_value_monthly all preserved; (g) PII transcript (SSN 123-45-6789 + DOB) triggers pii_exposure gate → qa_score capped at 59, qa_status=below_threshold, policy_compliance=Fail; (h) transcript with 'cancel my account' + 'third time' + 'overcharged' + 'looking at alternatives' → risk_score=80 (critical) with 4 signals cancellation_intent/repeat_contact/billing/competitor. Frontend: authenticated via seeded session cookie, drove /dashboard/interactions/int_77da1c8442 (Acme human), int_bcdab1b775 (Summit AI), int_83c6d94fc0 (NovaTech Emma) and confirmed — red alert banner renders for below_threshold/compliance/critical; rubric card shows 6 rows with weight labels (10%/20%/25%/15%/20%/10%), Fail/Marginal/Pass verdicts colored red/amber/green, reasons visible; churn card shows risk pill, Revenue-at-risk $9,360 for Acme, 5 signal pills + 4 keyword pills; coaching card shows strengths + improvements; AI · BLOCK pill surfaces on Support Bot v3 with compliance fail; NovaTech has no alert banner (qa_status=good). Logo: login/landing + dashboard sidebar both render the official RetOps PNG (xdswif0q_Retops company profile logo.png) inside the navy tile with mix-blend-mode:lighten; the 0-byte 32zs26da upload is NOT referenced anywhere.

minor.issue: Accepts ?customer=... but ignores it — only churn_risk and agent_type are filtered server-side. Consider either implementing the filter or documenting the supported params; silently-ignored query strings are confusing.

action_items: (Optional, minor) Implement the ?customer= filter on GET /api/interactions, or drop the param from frontend calls to avoid confusion.
(Carry-over from iter 4) server.py is ~753 lines — consider splitting into routers before growth.
(Carry-over) /api/activity loads up to 600 docs and sorts in memory; add aggregation/pagination for production.
(Carry-over) ActivityHistory.jsx has no loading/error UI and event rows are not keyboard-accessible.

save-playbook card is not rendered on Acme detail screen despite churn_risk=High (compliance.has_violation=false). Double-check the conditional render in InteractionDetail.jsx — spec expects the Save playbook card to appear for high-risk churn so CSMs see the 24h action plan.
critical_code_review_comments: llm_service._normalize_and_enforce correctly enforces hard-fail cap + banding + revenue_at_risk floor. Good defensive coding.
Churn risk_score is recomputed from signals regardless of LLM-given value (line 412-415), which makes scoring deterministic even if the model drifts — excellent.

_derive_legacy_shape collapses 4-level churn (low/medium/high/critical) into legacy 3-level (Low/Medium/High) with High covering both high+critical. This is consistent with the AllInteractions filter. Document this mapping in llm_service.py.
ai_verdict sanity pass (line 440-452) forces BLOCK on any violation but only sets REWRITE/SEND default if not already set. Good.

HARD_FAIL_GATES (line 365-369) includes 'hallucinated_feature' which is not in the spec-listed 7 gates but appears as a safety extension — fine. 'unsupported_ai_claim' is included as a hard-fail gate even though the spec only lists it as a churn signal; this is stricter than spec. Confirm with product whether this is intended (it caps AI interactions at 59 when they hallucinate, which matches Summit's observed behavior).
InteractionDetail.jsx save-playbook render is gated on some condition (not visible in the 100 lines read) — for Acme's qa_score=39.9 / churn High the card did not render. Confirm intended behavior.

Legacy expansion heuristic (tags 'upsell'/'expansion' or 'additional offices' substring) is brittle — NovaTech Emma Davis interaction currently shows expansion_signal only if those strings match. Consider moving expansion detection into the primary LLM schema as its own signal.
